name: static_site_generator
spec: Create a static site generator in Python using only the standard library (no Jinja2, no Markdown libraries). The tool reads content files written in a simple Markdown-like format with YAML-style front matter (parsed manually, no PyYAML), applies them to HTML templates, and outputs a complete static website. It supports blog posts, pages, and generates an index with navigation.
features: Reads content files from a content/ directory in Markdown format
Parses YAML-style front matter delimited by --- lines to extract title, date, tags, and template name
Converts basic Markdown (headings, bold, italic, links, lists, code blocks, paragraphs) to HTML
Reads HTML template files from a templates/ directory
Templates support placeholder variables using {{variable}} syntax that get replaced with content
Templates support a {{content}} placeholder where the converted Markdown body is inserted
Generates a blog index page listing all posts sorted by date with titles and dates
Generates a navigation menu from all pages (non-blog content) automatically
Outputs the complete generated site into an output/ directory with proper file structure
Copies static assets (CSS, images) from a static/ directory to the output
Generates clean URLs by creating directory/index.html for each page
Supports a --serve flag that starts a local HTTP server to preview the generated site
Supports a --clean flag that removes the output directory before building
Includes a sample site with at least 2 templates, 3 blog posts, and 2 pages to demonstrate functionality
